lines.en: Listen to the tape then answer this question.
When do the children do their homework?
lines.zh: 孩子们什么时候做家庭作业？

lines.en: The Sawyers live at 87 King Street.
lines.zh: 索耶一家住在国王街87号。

lines.en: In the morning, Mr. Sawyer goes to work and the children go to school.
lines.zh: 早上，索耶先生去上班，孩子们去上学。

lines.en: Their father takes them to school every day.
lines.zh: 他们的父亲每天送他们上学。

lines.en: Mrs. Sawyer stays at home every day.
lines.zh: 索耶夫人每天待在家里。

lines.en: She always eats her lunch at noon.
In the afternoon, she usually sees her friends.
In the evening, the children come home from school.
lines.zh: 晚上，孩子们从学校回家。

lines.en: Mr. Sawyer comes home from work.
At night, the children always do their homework.
lines.zh: 晚上，孩子们总是做家庭作业。

lines.en: Mr. Sawyer usually reads his newspaper, but sometimes he and his wife watch television.
lines.zh: 索耶先生通常看报纸，但有时他和妻子会看电视。
